$comment: Every KPost account this bench itself CREATED during a test run — the opposite of
test-accounts.json, which is exclusively the PRE-EXISTING, .env-declared accounts.
Appended to, never overwritten, by src/fixtures/created-accounts.ts's recordCreatedAccount().
Each entry is the kpostID and mobile number a signup/registration flow actually minted, so a
newly-created identity is never lost track of across runs. Committed to the repo (no secrets:
a kpostID and mobile are identifiers, not credentials).

Created while testing whether Business signup rejects a mobile number already registered to a DIFFERENT company. It did not reject it (adminRegistration returned 200 SUCCESS, companyID 1064) — confirmed CORRECT per the real business requirement (one mobile MAY have multiple Business accounts across different companies; only same-company duplicates must be rejected). Originally mis-filed as bug #818 (CRITICAL); retracted as INVALID once the requirement was clarified. Kept here per this bench's safety-net policy; not cleaned up (the API has no delete-company endpoint).

accounts.source: ad-hoc diagnostic probe (2026-09-29) via /usermanagement Add Manually
accounts.note: UNINTENDED side effect while testing same-company duplicate-mobile rejection for a real member of BUSINESS_S's company (1034, North Star Technology). Intended to reuse an existing member's exact mobile (Mark Fisher, 9696936363), but the Mobile No field's own input mask truncated/mangled the typed value ("919696936363") into "9196969363" — a DIFFERENT, new number, not a real duplicate. So this run did NOT actually test the intended scenario; it just created an extra real member by mistake. addingUserByAdmin returned 200 SUCCESS, companyID 1034. Not cleaned up (terminateUser is a permanent, non-reversible state change, not a deletion, and is itself on this bench's permanent do-not-automate list).
